title: Administrator
description:
Your new company

A leading organisation within the infrastructure and engineering sector is seeking an experienced and proactive Administrator to join their team in Falmer on a short-term temporary basis. This is an excellent opportunity to join a well-established business where you'll play a key role in supporting employee engagement, customer communications, community initiatives and day-to-day business operations.

This varied position would suit a highly organised administrator who enjoys working with people, managing multiple priorities and providing exceptional support across several business functions.

Your new role

As Administrator, you will act as a central point of coordination between internal teams, customers and external stakeholders. You'll provide comprehensive administrative support while helping to ensure effective communication across the organisation.

Key responsibilities will include:
- Supporting HR communications, employee engagement activities and internal announcements
- Assisting with the preparation and distribution of company communications and updates
- Acting as a first point of contact for customer enquiries and correspondence
- Supporting community engagement initiatives and stakeholder communications
- Coordinating meetings, diaries and team events
- Maintaining accurate records, databases and documentation
- Preparing reports, presentations and administrative paperwork
- Providing general office administration support to ensure smooth day-to-day operations
- Managing routine logistics and helping keep teams organised and efficient

This is a broad and varied position offering exposure to multiple areas of the business, making it ideal for someone who enjoys a busy and diverse role.

What you'll need to succeed

To be successful in this role, you'll have:
- Previous experience in an administrative, office support or coordinator position
- Excellent written and verbal communication skills
- Strong customer service and stakeholder engagement abilities
- Exceptional organisational skills with the ability to prioritise competing workloads
- A proactive and flexible approach to work
- High attention to detail and accuracy
- Strong Microsoft Office skills, including Outlook, Word and Excel
- The ability to build positive working relationships with colleagues, customers and external contacts

Experience supporting HR, communications, customer service or community-focused activities would be advantageous but is not essential.

What you'll get in return
- Immediate start available
- Monday to Friday working hours (9:00am - 5:00pm)
- 37.5 hours per week
- Opportunity to gain experience within a recognised organisation
- A diverse and engaging role with exposure to multiple business functions
- Supportive team environment
- Valuable experience that will enhance your administrative career

What you need to do now

If you're an organised and professional Administrator looking for your next opportunity and are available to start at short notice, we'd love to hear from you.

If you're interested in this role, click 'apply now' to forward an up-to-date copy of your CV, or call us now.

If this job isn't quite right for you, but you are looking for a new position, please contact us for a confidential discussion about your career.

title: Administrator - Patient Care Advisor
company: Care Unbound Limited t/a Here - Agency - Permanent
description:
Patient Care Advisors are the first point of contact for the people we serve.

This is a predominantly phone-based role requiring excellent interpersonal skills, an empathetic approach and a strong focus on resolving issues effectively.
They handle patient data and work within teams that belong to the overall service. They communicate and work with patients, local GP practices, hospital and community staff and clinicians to get patients to the most appropriate services for their needs accurately and on time.

Sussex MSK Health helps people who are experiencing MSK (aka musculoskeletal, or muscle and bone) conditions by seeing them in the community, rather than in a hospital. It is an NHS service delivered in partnership between Here and Sussex Community NHS Foundation Trust.

This role sits within the Sussex MSK Health service and is employed by Here. For more information, please visit our Carer Site.

title: Finance Assistant
description:
Finance Assistant

Brighton, East Sussex

About Us

77 Diamonds Limited and our subsidiaries are a multiple award-winning e-commerce retailer, supplying some of the world's finest diamond rings and jewellery to a host of discerning customers and specialising in engagement rings, wedding rings and fine diamond jewellery.

Boasting luxury showrooms in Frankfurt, Berlin, Munich, as well as the UK, Italy, Switzerland and Dubai, we also offer online retail options and bespoke, made-to-order pieces. This places us firmly at the forefront of a new breed of jeweller who focuses on the customer, embracing technology and modern manufacturing processes.

We are now looking for a Finance Assistant to join us on a full-time, permanent basis.

The Benefits
- Salary of £27,000 per annum
- Pension
- Reimbursed travel expenses
- Cycle to work scheme
- Summer hours
- Tech scheme
- Staff discounts
- Regular staff socials

This is an exciting opportunity for a detail-focused individual with experience in a fast-paced environment and exposure to multicurrency accounts to join our award-winning organisation.

You'll have the chance to build valuable experience within an international, multi-currency finance function, broadening your knowledge and strengthening both your technical confidence and commercial understanding.

What's more, you'll join a modern, technology-led luxury retailer with a global presence, where you can develop your career while enjoying summer hours, staff discounts and a sociable working culture.

So, if you're looking for a varied and engaging finance role within a modern international luxury brand, read on and apply today.

The Role

As a Finance Assistant, you will support the smooth running of our finance function by maintaining accurate financial records and ensuring the timely processing of transactions.

You will process high volumes of supplier invoices, credit notes and payments, matching invoices to purchase orders, reconciling accounts and ensuring all transactions are recorded in line with company accounting policies.

Working closely with colleagues and suppliers, you'll manage bank postings, payment reconciliations and supplier queries, helping to maintain strong relationships across the business and with external vendors.

Additionally, you will:
- Allocate vendor payments accurately and on time
- Manage the Accounting inbox
- Respond promptly to queries from colleagues and suppliers
- Prepare, review and check weekly payment runs
- Assist with accounts receivable allocations, reconciliations and postings
- Support the preparation of year-end audit files

About You

To be considered as a Finance Assistant, you will need:
- Experience working in a fast-paced environment
- Knowledge of accounting software MS Business Central D365 or similar
- Exposure to multicurrency accounts
- The ability to communicate articulately and efficiently
- Proficiency in MS Office and Google Suite
- A keen eye for detail, with strong problem-solving and numeracy skills
- To be comfortable working independently

Other organisations may call this role Accounts Assistant, Accounts Payable Assistant, Purchase Ledger Assistant, Finance Administrator, Accounts Administrator, Finance Officer, Accounts Clerk, Finance Clerk, Accounts Payable Clerk, or Purchase Ledger Clerk.

Webrecruit and 77 Diamonds Limited are equal opportunities employers, value diversity and are strongly committed to providing equal employment opportunities for all employees and all applicants for employment. Equal opportunities are the only acceptable way to conduct business and we believe that the more inclusive our environments are, the better our work will be.

So, if you're ready to grow a successful career as a Finance Assistant, please apply via the button shown. This vacancy is being advertised by Webrecruit. The services advertised by Webrecruit are those of an Employment Agency.

title: Financial Administrator
description:
Role: Practice AdministratorLocation: BrightonHours: Monday - Friday, 9:30am - 5:30pm (1 hour lunch break)Pay: £26,000 - £29,000 per annum

An excellent opportunity has arisen for a Practice Administrator to join one of our clients based in Brighton.

The business provides professional financial advice to a diverse client base across a range of planning and investment areas. The practice has built a strong reputation over a number of years, developing a loyal client base and continuing to grow steadily.

Benefits
- £26,000 - £29,000 basic salary
- Pension
- Opportunity to join a well-established practice

The Requirements
- Previous experience in an administration or PA role
- Experience working within a partner financial planning practice is advantageous
- Proficient in Microsoft Office (Outlook, Word, Excel, PowerPoint)
- Experience using CRM or client management systems (e.g. Salesforce) beneficial
- Strong written and verbal communication skills with excellent client interaction
- Highly organised with strong attention to detail
- Ability to manage competing priorities and work to deadlines
- Self-motivated with a proactive, positive attitude
- Comfortable working independently and taking initiative

The Role
- Greeting clients and supporting them ahead of meetings with the Financial Adviser
- Managing the adviser's diary, arranging and coordinating client appointments
- Preparing client welcome packs and review documentation
- Maintaining and updating client records on internal systems and CRM platforms
- Preparing and obtaining quotations and illustrations from product providers
- Processing applications accurately and preparing relevant pre- and post-sale documentation
- Sending and following up letters of authority with financial institutions
- Assisting with fund switches and withdrawal requests
- Drafting basic suitability reports for reviews and simple advice cases
- Producing investment performance charts and supporting analysis where required
- Liaising with clients and external contacts via telephone and email
- Providing general administrative support including filing, scanning and document preparation
- Supporting the organisation of client events
- Maintaining office supplies and supporting the smooth day-to-day running of the office

If you're keen to join an exceptional team who can offer a supportive environment within a well-established and growing practice, then please apply to this Practice Administrator role below or call Angela on between 9:00am - 5:30pm.

title: Medical Receptionist Apprentice
description:
Job Title: Medical Receptionist Apprentice

Apprenticeship: Level 3 Business Administrator Apprenticeship

Location: Brighton

Salary: £9.60 per hour (£18,500 per annum)

Hours: Full-time, Monday - Friday, 8:30am - 5:00pm

This is an exciting opportunity to join a busy and professional healthcare environment as a Medical Receptionist Apprentice.

You will play an important role in supporting patients and the wider practice team, helping to ensure patients receive an efficient and welcoming service while developing valuable administration, communication and customer service skills.

Benefits
- Gain valuable experience within a professional healthcare environment
- Dedicated workplace mentor and structured training
- Develop administration, customer service and IT skills
- Real-world responsibilities from day one
- Opportunity for long-term career progression upon successful completion of the apprenticeship

Requirements
- GCSEs (Grade A-C / 4-9) including English and Mathematics, or equivalent
- Excellent written and verbal communication skills
- Positive, proactive and flexible approach to work
- Confident and professional manner
- Strong organisational and time management skills
- Ability to prioritise your workload effectively
- Friendly and polite telephone manner
- Confident using computers and Microsoft Office applications
- Enjoys working as part of a team and supporting others
- Willingness to learn and develop new skills

Responsibilities for an Apprentice
- Scan and process incoming post and patient documentation
- Process new patient registrations and online access requests
- Send patient information via post, email and relevant systems
- Assist with medical report requests and administrative duties
- Welcome patients and provide excellent customer service at reception
- Process appointment requests both in person and over the telephone
- Record home visit requests and liaise with clinicians where appropriate
- Maintain accurate patient records and update information on practice systems
- Process repeat prescription requests in accordance with practice guidelines
- Answer telephone calls, take messages and direct queries appropriately
- Work in accordance with practice procedures and written protocols

Apprenticeship Information

You will be enrolled on the Level 3 Business Administrator Apprenticeship, typically completed over 18 months. This includes:
- Regular workplace-based learning supported by your training provider and line manager
- A minimum of 6 hours per week of off-the-job training
- Development of skills, knowledge and behaviours aligned to the apprenticeship standard
- Completion of a portfolio and end-point assessment
- Functional Skills support in English or Maths if not previously achieved at Level 2

Prospects

Once you have completed your apprenticeship there will be the opportunity to potentially go into a permanent based role.

For more information or to apply to this Medical Receptionist Apprentice role, please contact Jamie Watson at Next Step Apprenticeships on (Mon - Fri, 9:00am - 5:30pm).

title: Patient Care Coordinator
description:
Role: Patient Care Coordinator

Location: Brighton & Hove

Hours: Mondays and Fridays, with additional ad hoc shifts available

Pay: £12.71 per hour

Contract: Temporary

An excellent opportunity has arisen for a Patient Care Coordinator to join one of our longstanding clients, a busy healthcare organisation in Brighton & Hove.

This is a fantastic temporary opportunity for an experienced Patient Care Coordinator with EMIS Web experience to support a busy healthcare team. You will be the first point of contact for patients, delivering excellent customer service while ensuring the smooth running of appointments and day-to-day administrative processes.

Benefits
- Weekly pay
- Flexible temporary work with additional ad hoc shifts available
- Opportunity to work within a friendly and supportive healthcare team
- Immediate start available

The Requirements
- Previous experience using EMIS Web is essential
- Previous experience within a GP practice or healthcare setting
- Strong administration and IT skills
- Professional and confident telephone manner
- Excellent communication and customer service skills
- Ability to handle confidential and sensitive information
- Organised, reliable and able to work under pressure
- Available to work every Monday and Friday
- Current DBS certificate is advantageous

The Role
- Welcome patients and respond to enquiries professionally
- Answer incoming telephone calls and deal with patient queries
- Book, amend and cancel patient appointments
- Maintain and monitor the appointment system
- Signpost patients to the appropriate healthcare professional or service
- Enter and update patient information using EMIS Web
- Process emails, correspondence and patient registrations
- Support clinical and administrative colleagues with day-to-day tasks
- Maintain accurate, confidential patient records
- Deliver a friendly, professional and efficient service at all times

If you're keen to join an exceptional team offering flexible temporary work within a supportive healthcare environment, then please apply to this Patient Care Coordinator role below or call Chloe McCausland on between 8:30am - 5:00pm.
